name: headers-on-a-later-frame
description: The dialer opens a stream, sends one ordinary data frame, and then puts headers on a second one. Headers ride the first frame a peer sends on a stream or no frame at all (WSM-FRM-016), and a second set is a stream-level error: the peers still agree about every other stream and about the connection, so only this one dies (§4.3). The first data frame is deliberately headerless - what makes the third frame illegal is that it is not the first, not that headers were used twice.
